description: This file contains implementations of fake tensor operations and utilities for PyTorch, including registration of operators, fast implementation paths, shape inference, and handling of symbolic shapes for fake tensors.

classes.name: FakeTensor
classes.description: Class representing a fake tensor used for symbolic shape tracking and operator simulation.
